fato_historico: 1992: NASA launches Space Shuttle Endeavour on STS-47 which marked the 50th shuttle mission. On board are Mae Carol Jemison, the first African-American woman in space, Mamoru Mohri, the first Japanese citizen to fly in a US spaceship, and Mark Lee and Jan Davis, the first married couple in space.
energia_do_dia: The stars align today, inviting you to reach toward the heavens just like explorers venturing into the vast unknown. Perhaps it is a good time to expand your horizons beyond familiar boundaries. Consider how diverse perspectives, much like a unique crew united in orbit, can elevate your own personal journey toward growth and beautiful new discoveries.
frase_do_dia: The sky is not the limit when your spirit soars with purpose.
significado_numero: Representing a milestone mission of infinite curiosity and collective success.
conselho: Embrace collaboration and welcome the unexpected magic that unfolds today.
